answer: An AI-agent market issues a quill credential only after an account locks 100 tokens for 30 days. Each daily pulse verifies the lock, while the escrow contract forbids one deposit from backing multiple accounts. A hollow alias therefore needs separate collateral. Each extra fake ties up another 100 tokens and costs about 0.99 tokens per 30-day term at a 12% annual capital cost. Refunding the deposit does not recover that financing cost.
